summary: Publish typed push registration clients and the opt-in build proof

replay.detail: No additional claim or projection replay.

schema.detail: Generated client models project the push registration contract; no additional persistent state change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Rust, TypeScript and Swift clients expose paired-session push register/unregister methods and safe device registration summaries. The optional capability remains required before use; no sender is added.

manual.detail: Ordinary iOS prebuild entitlements and signing configuration remain unchanged. Push capture is opt-in through ST_IOS_PUSH=1 and the phone setting.
